description: Self-written report with two call-path claims from curl_easy_perform: a real chain through the multi interface, and a made-up target that has never existed in curl. Covers call path CONFIRMED + CONTRADICTED.

report.title: Unchecked chunk copy reachable from curl_easy_perform
report.body:
Tested on curl 8.23.0.

`curl_easy_perform` runs every transfer through the multi interface: it calls `easy_perform` (lib/easy.c line 855), which calls `easy_transfer` (line 833), which calls `curl_multi_perform` (line 729).

For chunked responses, `curl_easy_perform` eventually reaches `Curl_http_chunk_unsafe_copy` in lib/http_chunks.c, which copies each chunk without checking its size.

claim.source_excerpt: it calls `easy_perform` (lib/easy.c line 855), which calls `easy_transfer` (line 833), which calls `curl_multi_perform` (line 729)

evidence.note: Inside easy_perform (lines 770-848); events is FALSE on this path.
The target has never existed in curl. Pending the not-found agreement (#10): a checker reports it as not found, and CONTRADICTED comes only after the history check.
